# Account ID18 lists for Salesforce filters

Generated from data/accounts.csv. Two sets are provided.

- **Working book** (602 accounts): in-book plus needs-ownership-check. Excludes what routes out and the duplicate record.
- **Everything on the board** (609 accounts).

## The constraint, before you start

A Salesforce report filter value maxes out at **255 characters**. An 18-character ID plus a
comma is 19, so **13 IDs is the most that fits in one filter** (13 x 18 + 12 commas = 246).
Lightning reports allow **20 filters**, so one report tops out around **260 IDs**.

With 602 accounts in the working book, that is **47 filters**, which no single report can hold.
Chunks of 13 are below anyway, but see the SOQL section first, it does the whole thing in one paste.

---

## SOQL, the one that actually works

Paste into Developer Console (Query Editor) or Workbench. SOQL has no 255-character limit,
so all of them go in one query.

```sql
SELECT Id, Name, BillingCity, BillingPostalCode, AnnualRevenue, Industry, Owner.Name
FROM Account
WHERE Id IN
